name: dairy-grow-built-paid-v1
description: ⭐ DEAN'S DAIRY EXPERIMENT (12/09/2026), arm paid. Build, then immediately GROW the building just built, PAYING a matching activation card as normal. The stack advances, so the clog brake survives and a Tier 3 at threshold 1 jams the instant it is grown. This is a TEMPO rule and not a price cut: nothing about the cost curve moves. ⛔ C100 IS OPEN AND THIS IS AN ARM ON TOP OF AN ARM: the shipped default is still visitCurrency 'commons'. The control is overlays/notice-board-visit-host-draw-by-seats-v1.overlay.json and every one of its twenty passengers is pinned here by name. ⛔ 30 of the 90 deck cards (every Power, every Endgame) have NO threshold and NO activation type, so this clause is DEAD on a third of the deck by construction, which is what stops the Dairy board becoming the cheap route to the Power layer. ⚠️ You may never visit your own board, so a stronger Dairy board is a gift to Dairy's RIVALS; what Dairy gets is traffic, and traffic is fee cards to harvest. ⛔ MAY NOT BE QUOTED: the bonus rate is a share of TURNS and never plays per turn; no level is comparable with a reference-v14 or earlier number; the barn glut reads per-seat, never the pooled median.
